definitions.gloss: to doze, to slumber, to drowse
definitions.explanation: To sleep lightly or briefly, hovering between wakefulness and sleep. A gentle, literary word for drifting in and out of shallow sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{微睡|まどろ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was dozing on the sofa.
The cat is dozing in the afternoon sunlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心地|ここち}よい→心地よい：12515_kokochiyoi⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{吹|ふ}かれて→吹く：02445_fuku⟧{微睡|まどろ}むうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦いつの{間|ま}にか→いつの間にか：01812_itsunomanika⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}っていた→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: As I drowsed in the pleasant breeze, I fell asleep before I knew it.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and poetic verb. The kanji {微睡|まどろ}む literally combines "subtle" ({微|び}) and "sleep" ({睡|すい}), capturing the sense of light, gentle sleep. More evocative and elegant than ⟦うとうとする→うとうとする：26856_utoutosuru⟧ (to nod off) or ⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to doze off). Commonly used in literature, poetry, and refined descriptive writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微睡|まどろ}み⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{覚|さ}める→覚める：02058_sameru⟧: to wake from a doze
- {微睡|まどろ}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in a state of slumber

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦うとうとする→うとうとする：26856_utoutosuru⟧: to nod off (casual)
- ⟦{居眠|いねむ}り→居眠り：01822_inemuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fall asleep (unintentionally, as at a desk)
